description: This Java class 'LocationDbHelper' provides helper methods to create, upgrade, and interact with a SQLite database that stores GPS location data such as latitude, longitude, timestamp, and day. It includes methods for inserting, reading, and deleting location entries, and is part of an Android application for tracking speed based on GPS data.

classes.name: LocationDbHelper
classes.description: A helper class extending SQLiteOpenHelper to manage database creation, upgrade, and CRUD operations for location data.

methods.name: LocationDbHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the database helper with context, database name, and version.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates the location table in the database.

methods.name: onUpgrade
methods.description: Handles database schema upgrades by dropping existing table and recreating it.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a LocationEntry object into the database.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves a list of LocationEntry objects for a specific day based on a Calendar instance.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes all entries for a given day or calendar date.
